# Tech CU Digital Card Service

> Legal and compliance documentation for Tech CU's digital card service platform in the United States.

Tech CU Digital Card Service provides digital payment card solutions with comprehensive legal disclosures and terms of service. The platform serves United States users through a mobile-first digital card application.

## Key Topics

- Digital Card Service
- Tech CU
- Mobile App
- Terms of Service
- Legal Agreement
- Disclosure
- Software License
- Intellectual Property
- Usage Restrictions
- United States

## Legal & Compliance

- [Disclosure Document](https://techcu.digitalcardservice.com/app/documents/en-US/disclosure.jsp): Tech CU Digital Card Service disclosure and legal agreement document covering terms, restrictions, and user obligations
